pr_title: sql: disallow identifiers after numeric constants
pr_body:
Release note (sql change): Match Postgres 15 behavior and disallow
identifiers after numeric constants not separated by whitespace.

Fixes #111037

issue_context.title: sql: disallow identifiers after numeric constants without whitespace
issue_context.body:
We currently allow identifiers after numeric constants without separation. For example:

```
defaultdb> SELECT 123foo;
  foo
-------
  123
(1 row)
```

This matched Postgres's behavior up until Postgres 15 (see the commit where this change was made: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/2549f0661bd28571d7200d6f82f752a7ee5d47e1). Now Postgres returns an error:

```
marcus=# SELECT 123foo;
ERROR:  42601: trailing junk after numeric literal at or near "123f"
LINE 1: SELECT 123foo;
               ^
LOCATION:  scanner_yyerror, scan.l:1192
```

We should match this behavior and return an error as well.



Jira issue: CRDB-31735
